messages.body_plain:
Hello,

after the update of the statet plugin the r-help don't work anymore. After
"Run help"

the help window shows only

"no page at this time"

In the help preferences is written:

"erhelp:/browse/default-workbench/"

Also if I type in the console, it's the same result.

What can I do?

Thank you very much

Christian


PS.
Ubuntu 12.04 amd54,  Eclipse 4.3, Statet 3.3.0

set breakpoints _before_ you execute the function.
